{{Top|leg}}
The '''Central Council''' was the ruling body of the [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. As the Anomids were largely pacifists, the Central Council routinely refused any requests from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or other groups to work in weapons development.
